zones.name: design DNA and theme
zones.notes: Never edit generated theme files: change design.dna.ts then `pnpm dss theme`, or `pnpm dss dna roll --lock...`.

zones.name: copy and text
zones.notes: All visible text lives in content/. Specific facts beat adjectives; the slop gate refuses cliches.

zones.name: header, navigation, footer
zones.notes: Nav items come from site.manifest.ts pages (nav: true) and labels from content/site.ts nav.

zones.name: SEO and structured data
zones.notes: pageMetadata/rootMetadata and JSON-LD builders from @dss/seo; never hand-write <meta>. /dss-seo.

zones.name: security headers and CSP
zones.notes: Add third-party origins through security.csp presets or sources in the manifest, never in next.config.ts.

zones.name: pages and routes
zones.notes: New page: `pnpm dss g page /route --sections hero,faq,cta`. Redirects belong in the manifest.

zones.name: sections and layout blocks
zones.notes: Registry first: `pnpm dss add list`, `pnpm dss add section <id> --page /route`; bespoke: `pnpm dss g section <name>`.

zones.name: 3D and WebGL
zones.notes: three.js only inside components/3d, rendered through <Scene> (lazy, poster fallback, reduced motion).

zones.name: motion and animation
zones.notes: Motion (motion/react) and CSS; composite-only properties; respect prefers-reduced-motion. No GSAP.

zones.name: visual edit from the browser (AimKit)
zones.notes: Read the latest capture with the aimkit MCP get_context (with_images false first). /dss-edit.
